title: Coding Agents for Coding Theory
abstract: arXiv:2609.39081v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We spent five weeks using an LLM coding agent on open problems in coding theory: finding large sets of four-letter words, such as DNA barcodes, that stay far apart in edit distance. The agent wrote the verifiers and search code; a human chose the problem and set the verification protocol. Restricting the search to codes with a prescribed symmetry, a classical technique, shrank the problem about fourfold and raised the best known code of length 6 and minimum edit distance 3 from 114 to 120 words ($E_4(6,3) \geq 120$). The same pipeline improved twelve further lower bounds at lengths 6 to 9 and distances 3 to 6. We give the failures equal space. Our own search stopped at 116 and recorded the last symmetry class as topping out at 112; a second agent session, running the same search with a better operator, found the 120. translated_title: 面向编码理论的编码智能体
translated_abstract: 我们花了五周时间使用大语言模型（LLM）编码智能体来解决编码理论中的开放问题：寻找大量在编辑距离上彼此保持足够远离的四字母词集合，例如DNA条形码。智能体负责编写验证器和搜索代码；人类负责选择问题并制定验证协议。将搜索限制在具有规定对称性的编码上（这是一种经典技术），使问题规模缩小了约四倍，并将长度为6、最小编辑距离为3的最优已知编码从114个词提升到120个词（E_4(6,3) ≥ 120）。同样的流程还改进了长度6至9、距离3至6范围内的另外十二个下界。我们也以同样的篇幅记录了失败案例：我们自己的搜索止步于116，并记录下最后一个对称类的上限为112；第二次智能体会话使用更好的算子运行相同的搜索，才找到了120。后来关于该方法无法推广到长度7的结论也因同样的原因而出错，更早的一个实例也……
tldr: 研究者让LLM编码智能体在人类设定的验证协议下自主搜索编码理论开放问题，通过对称性约简将十三个编辑距离编码的下界纪录加以提升，其中包括将E_4(6,3)从114提升到120，同时也如实记录了智能体搜索的失败经历。
en_tdlr: LLM coding agents, operating under human-set verification protocols, improved thirteen lower bounds in coding theory through symmetry-restricted search—including raising E_4(6,3) from 114 to 120—while the authors candidly document the agents' failures as well.
